ref.locator: Source fpd-monthly-stat-2026-04 (https://www.sfpd.fgov.be/media/Stat/Maandelijks/nl_stat_2604.pdf), PDF p. 22, Tabel 2.2, block 'Totalen – Mannen en vrouwen', column 'Totaal': row 'Aantal – Werknemers' and row 'Bedrag – Werknemers: pensioen + bonus' (situation April 2026). Calculation: 3,379,381,837.43 / 2,353,477 = 1,435.91 EUR per person per month.
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: The candidate's figure (1,555.23 'Gemiddeld bedrag', column 'Werknemer') is printed correctly, but the label 'employee-only career' is wrong. That column means 'employee pension and no self-employed pension'; it still contains people who also have a civil-service pension. Cross-check with the FPD annual statistics 2025 (Jan 2025, tables 1.1.4 and 1.1.6): pure employee career 1,431,026 + employee & civil-servant 390,180 = 1,821,206, which is close to the 1,815,675 in the April 2026 'Werknemer' column. The 390,180 mixed employee/civil-servant people get only about 495 EUR a month from the employee scheme (193,201,968.90 / 390,180). The corrected unit is what the line actually pays per person: every employee-scheme beneficiary, including the employee part of mixed careers, with retirement and survivor's pensions and the pension bonus included. It is the full employee-scheme amount booked for April 2026, divided by the number of people receiving an employee pension (simple stated arithmetic on two figures printed in the same table). Gross: the FPD annual statistics (p. 3, 'Bedragen') say amounts are always gross monthly amounts. The amount excludes the holiday allowance paid in May, and many recipients also get a pension from another scheme. It is April 2026, so before the 1 Sept 2026 indexation (FPD indexation page: 01.09.2026 index 186,83). Alternative if a 'typical full pensioner' unit is preferred: the pure employee-career average from the FPD annual statistics 2025, PDF table 1.1.4 'Zuivere loopbaan werknemer ~ Mannen en vrouwen', row 'Totaal': 2,483,716,563.33 / 1,431,026 = 1,735.62 EUR gross/month (January 2025; this includes survivors). Re-verified: 2,823,792,233.52 / 1,815,675 = 1,555.23 (the original arithmetic is right; only the label is wrong). Researcher's working: - Average of the monthly amount booked for 1,815,675 people whose only FPD pension is an employee pension (situation 1 April 2026). Includes survivors' pensions, so it is not the average retirement pension of a full career. Excludes the yearly holiday allowance paid in May, so 12 x this amount understates the yearly cost per pensioner. People with mixed employee + self-employed careers (537,802) are in a separate column; people with an employee + civil-service career are counted here for their employee part only. The monthly report does not itself say 'bruto'; the FPD annual statistics state their amounts are always gross monthly amounts before withholding tax, health-insurance and solidarity deductions (fpd-annual-stat-2025, p. 3 'Bedragen'), and the totals in table 2.2 match the gross expenditure in table 1.1 of the same report. Averages are 'very general' per the FPD's own warning (PDF p. 19, intro of Deel 2). Unit: 12 × the monthly amount (1,435.91 × 12 = 17,230.92 EUR), so the yearly budget change is compared with a year of the benefit, not with one month.

ref.quote: Bedrag van het gewaarborgd minimumpensioen werknemers/het gemengd gewaarborgd minimumpensioen voor een volledige loopbaan(vanaf 01.09.2026 aan index 186,83) Rustpensioen aan het gezinsbedrag Rustpensioen aan het bedrag alleenstaande Overlevingspensioen of overgangsuitkering Bruto jaarbedrag 28 219,84 EUR 22 582,98 EUR 22 281,18 EUR Bruto maandbedrag 2 351,65 EUR 1 881,92 EUR 1 856,77 EUR
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Re-indexed. The FPD indexation page (https://www.sfpd.fgov.be/nl/pensioenbedrag/berekening/indexering, table 'Overzicht indexaanpassingen sinds 2000') lists '01.03.2026 183,17' and '01.09.2026 186,83'. The official FPD minimum-pension page gives 22,582.98 EUR/year (1,881.92/month) from 1 Sept 2026, replacing the 22,139.15 from the FPS Social Security notice of 1 March 2026 (that figure was verified: index_0326 PDF p. 10, 'bedrag alleenstaande 22.139,15 EUR'). I did not find an FPS Social Security 'officieel bericht' for September 2026: the 010926-index-nl/fr.pdf URLs return 404. The FPD (which pays the pension) and the RSVZ both publish 22,582.98 for 01.09.2026. The amount was 22,139.15 from March to August 2026, so it does not cover all of 2026. It is a legal minimum, not an average; access conditions apply (2/3 career, 208 days per year, 5,000 effectively worked days); holiday allowance excluded. 'Bedrag alleenstaande' is the single rate, which married people can also receive, so the label says 'single rate' and not 'a single person'. The FPD page says its text on conditions still has to be updated for the Pensioenwet of 1 June 2026; the amounts are explicitly dated 01.09.2026. Researcher's working: - Legal minimum, not an average. Household rate is 27,665.22 EUR/year. Amount valid from 1 March 2026; a later 2026 index jump (pivot index exceeded June 2026, see RVA amounts valid from 1 September 2026) probably raised it again, but I could not find the FPS Social Security notice for that later date. Access conditions apply (career and effective-work requirements). Excludes the holiday allowance.
